title: Line sketch: Swirling Orbs and Emblem
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: Abstract composition split between and swirling fields, featuring concentric circles with rims on the left and a floating orb above on the right. An ornate winged creature is mounted on the section, introducing a sculptural, three-dimensional focal point against the flat painted surface. Bold and curved forms create dynamic movement across the page (derived from painting #90).
